summary: ADR-0057 accepted 2026-08-05; knowledge publication owned only by maintain-knowledge-base with separate append-only request and explicit maintainer confirmation; request binds caller, trigger, one target plan, pinned main commit, non-automatic status, timestamp, knowledge-publication authority, and hash-verified stale maintenance route; publish_knowledge_catalog.py --publish fails closed without bindings; Acceptance emits typed hash-bound non-authorizing stale stop route persisted append-only in target plan; VDD/Acceptance restrict outputs to exact declared target plan; global semantic indexing excludes authority manifests and knowledge contexts to prevent recursive closure; standalone catalog builder read-only, publication gate alone activates formal layers/pointers with validated capability; versioned top-level requirements/contract/state/command files select highest numeric version, supporting requirements-ledger and requirements names; historical/read-only checks remain compatible, new publications record summary and hash; extends ADR-0044/0048/0050, supersedes none
